StoryAtlas execution container for the owner-authorized 2026-09-22 M1 goal. Canonical cross-repository charter: storymodel4s/docs/refactor/goals/source-recall-workspace-m1-20260922.md; local entry: docs/delivery/workspace-m1.md. StoryModel goal: bd-01M34J9FS10B14WQA309K0P6V8. Foreign IDs are provenance only.

Deliver a dynamic checked loader, one semantic selection with independent source/recall clocks/horizons, source reading plus minimal matrix and existing projection navigation, exact permitted evidence, saved-state replay and selected export. The existing adoption and split-screen tickets are reused; no wholesale import of the uncommitted 34-item proposal.

The local chain is provider adoption -> dynamic loader -> shared selection/matrix/evidence -> save/reopen/export -> exact-pair workflow acceptance. The adoption issue holds the external provider wait. Container relationships do not block execution. Completion requires the final acceptance receipt, not just all child statuses.

M1 does not require automatic scenes/episodes, automatic recall proposition charts, calibrated probabilities, reference-measurement inference, temporal-organization readouts, new corpus admission, structural-channel efficacy comparisons, film playback, autobiographical interviews, virtualization, population views or general chronology. Existing film/release commitments remain on their own lanes. Use redistributable WOG and synthetic fixtures; no participant prose, sealed-test opening, hosted API spend or new remote calls. One implementation writer and one heavy gate at a time; no fleet claims/reservations/candidates.
set.title: M1: inspect, save and reopen one joined source-recall workspace
